question: When a thick glass slab is placed over printed matter, the letters appear raised. This is due to ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Refraction of light**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Refraction of light** occurs when light passes from one medium to another, causing a change in its speed and direction. This phenomenon is responsible for the letters appearing raised when viewed through a thick glass slab.
 
• The glass slab acts as a medium with a higher refractive index compared to air. When light enters the glass slab, it bends toward the normal, and when it exits, it bends away from the normal.
 
• Due to the bending of light rays, the apparent position of the letters shifts. This shift creates the illusion that the letters are raised above
